pricing.stubNote: In this build, card top-ups and bank payouts are Stripe stubs: you see the full flow, but no real money moves.

items.q: How do you know a sign-up came from a post?
items.a: Each collaboration gets its own tracked link. Every click on it is saved with the time and the source. A small pixel on your site then ties each sign-up back to that click, so you see the post and the creator behind it.
Brands pay €0 per month. You pay each creator's fixed price for each post that gets published. Creators join free and set their own price, from €20 per post.

Brands keep a wallet. When a post is live and the brand pays for it, a ledger row is written and the creator sees it in their earnings. In this build, card top-ups and bank payouts are Stripe stubs: the flow is all there, but no real money moves.

items.q: Do I have to sign a long contract?
items.a: No subscription, no retainer. Each collaboration stands on its own: one offer, one brief, one approved draft, one post. And creators aren't exclusive to anyone.
The live numbers on this page come from a demo workspace filled with sample data. They show what tracking looks like, not results from real customers.

items.q: Can I cancel? Is there a commitment?
items.a: There's nothing to cancel. Brands have no subscription and pay per published post. Creators only take the offers they want.
